thread:
alex: FYI found an SDK vs REST parity bug in the Python samples: REST accepts 'assertion' in auth payload for service-account exchange, SDK raises 400. broke sample-app CI today.

kyle: can you paste the payloads?

alex: REST body used by curl: {"grant_type":"urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer", "assertion":"<jwt>"} and returns 200. Python SDK call client.auth.exchange_jwt(assertion='<jwt>') yields 400 missing grant_type.

mara: that sounds like SDK is not injecting grant_type when wrapping call. probably a mapping oversight in the auth helper.

kyle: repro'd. SDK helper constructs {'assertion': val} but server expects grant_type present. generator assumed server would default. I'll patch to include grant_type constant.

devx-bot: Created issue INF-3550: "Python SDK auth helper missing grant_type for jwt exchange" assigned to kyle.

kyle: PR 724 opened, adding explicit grant_type and unit test. I'll ship 0.14.2-patch after tests.

alex: nice, thanks — sample-app CI green after patch. please add a quick note in auth docs showing both curl and SDK examples so users don't get tripped.
